_comment: The mutants each baselined unit's baseline run killed (PIT) or detected (Stryker), as signature -> count, matched without line numbers: PIT method|mutator|description, Stryker mutator|original code|replacement. scripts/pit-summary.py and stryker-summary.py --kills list every one no longer killed (review r2, design F15); --write-kills writes it. From the runs gradle/mutation-baseline.json's scores come from: mutation_all 43629689255, and 43643527993 for js/joust/src/toolchain-heap.js. For the two "count": "killed" files only Killed mutants are recorded.
